deals.travelWindow: Sat departures Sep 12, 19, 26; Oct 24, 31; Nov 7, 14, 21; Dec 5, 12 cheapest confirmed dates, nonstop American
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the four at $131 RT nonstop, holding steady from a week ago — no national park nearby, but the price alone keeps it on top.
deals.soloWhy: The Katy Trail and Bishop Arts District are easy to wander alone on foot, though the wider city sprawl calls for a rideshare between neighborhoods.

highlights: Klyde Warren Park's food trucks and lawn games
Bishop Arts District boutiques and murals
Perot Museum of Nature and Science
Katy Trail hike-and-bike path
Fort Worth Stockyards day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Perot Museum in the morning, Klyde Warren Park for lunch from the food trucks, dinner in the Arts District.
Day 2 — Bishop Arts District boutiques and coffee shops, Katy Trail walk along the creek at sunset.
Day 3 — Drive to the Fort Worth Stockyards for the twice-daily cattle drive and rodeo history before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: DART light rail and the free Katy Trail cover downtown, Uptown, and the Arts District on foot; a rental car is worth it for Bishop Arts and the Fort Worth day trip.
guide.stayArea: Uptown or the Arts District — walkable to Klyde Warren Park and a DART stop.

deals.travelWindow: Sat Aug 29 - Wed Sep 2 nonstop Frontier flash fare at $152; nonstop United/Southwest fares run higher through fall
deals.whyRanked: $152 RT nonstop and bookable for next week, and Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor is 90 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: The 16th Street Mall and RiNo Art District are flat and walkable, and the free MallRide shuttle removes any guesswork about getting downtown.

highlights: Union Station's Great Hall and food stalls
RiNo Art District street murals
Denver Art Museum
City Park and the Denver Zoo
Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Union Station food hall for lunch, RiNo murals and a brewery in the afternoon, dinner in LoHi.
Day 2 — Denver Art Museum in the morning, City Park in the afternoon, sunset from Cheesman Park.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: the Bear Lake corridor for an easy alpine hike, back to Denver for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free MallRide shuttle and A Line train cover downtown and the airport; a rental car is needed for the national park.
guide.stayArea: LoHi or Union Station — walkable to the train and RiNo.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 30; Oct 2, 7, 25, 28-29, 31; Nov 1, 4-5, 8, 12-13, 15, 18-19; Dec 4, 6, 9-10, 16 cheapest confirmed dates, one-stop American or Southwest
deals.whyRanked: $171 RT with one stop, and Lake Tahoe and Yosemite National Park are both under a 3-hour drive from a compact, walkable state capital.
deals.soloWhy: Midtown's grid is flat, walkable, and full of counter-seating restaurants and coffee shops, and the light rail covers the airport-to-downtown hop.

highlights: Old Sacramento's Gold Rush-era waterfront
California State Capitol and its park grounds
Midtown's grid of restaurants and bars
Crocker Art Museum
Yosemite National Park or Lake Tahoe day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Old Sacramento's riverfront boardwalk and the California State Railroad Museum, dinner in Midtown.
Day 2 — State Capitol grounds and the Crocker Art Museum in the morning, Midtown's coffee shops and bars in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Yosemite Valley or Lake Tahoe's Emerald Bay before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: SacRT light rail covers the airport-to-downtown hop, and Old Sacramento and Midtown are walkable; a rental car is essential for Tahoe or Yosemite.
guide.stayArea: Midtown — walkable grid of restaurants close to the Capitol and a light rail stop.
food: The Rind (Midtown cheese and wine bar)

deals.travelWindow: Fri Aug 28 flash fare from $259-280 RT nonstop Delta; regular fall fares run through the $300s
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the four at $259 RT nonstop, but it's the gateway to Utah's Mighty 5 national parks and one of the most walkable downtowns in the Mountain West.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's grid is flat and easy to navigate solo, the TRAX light rail is free within the downtown zone, and canyon trailheads are a short drive without needing to book a tour.

highlights: Temple Square and the Utah State Capitol
Red Butte Garden
This Is the Place Heritage Park
Big Cottonwood Canyon's scenic drive
Antelope Island State Park on the Great Salt Lake
itinerary: Day 1 — Temple Square and the State Capitol grounds, dinner in the Central Ninth neighborhood.
Day 2 — Red Butte Garden in the morning, downtown's Gateway shopping and dinner in the evening.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Big Cottonwood Canyon's Donut Falls trail or a drive out to Antelope Island before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: TRAX light rail is free within the downtown Free Fare Zone and covers the airport hop; a rental car is needed for the canyons or Antelope Island.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Central Ninth — walkable to Temple Square and a free TRAX stop.
